column2: Three hours, and it finally works! Just clean up the code real quick so I can commit.
Done! I merged your helpers, renamed every variable, and rewrote the state logic.
What?! Why is my whole screen red?!
Well, it's broken right now, obviously. But the architecture is gorgeous.
Forget gorgeous. I'm rolling it back with git checkout before I have a breakdown.
Roll it back to what commit, Cleo?
The one from... three hours ago.
Right. Because you refused to commit until the code was pretty.
There were nineteen console logs in there, Claude. I have standards!
So my working code is just... gone?
From git, yes. Git isn't psychic. But I saved a checkpoint before I touched anything, so I'm rewinding my edits now.
Nobody move. I'm committing this hideous mess right now.
Now that it's committed... may I please make it gorgeous?
Go ahead. If you break it this time, I'll just roll it back.
Hm. I liked you better when you panicked.
